title: Restore unscoped work-item listing
objective: Restore sdlc work-item list and sdlc work-item list --json as unscoped top-level inventory commands while preserving explicit --work-item selection behavior for task listing.

branch.name: main
branch.rationale: The repository is already on the main branch and the user requested preparation, processing, and per-task commits on the current repository.

request.text:
we broke sdlc work-item list -- it's expected a --work-item <work-item-id>

it should be:

sdlc work-item list
sdlc work-item list --json

Prepare a .docs/work-items/ to fix this bug

Commit the work item.

Process the new work item, committing per task.

scope.name: unscoped-work-item-list
scope.description: Restore sdlc work-item list as an unscoped inventory command that lists all valid work-item records below .docs/work-items/.
scope.reason: WI-0003 accidentally made the top-level inventory route require a selector that is only appropriate for task listing.

scope.name: json-work-item-list
scope.description: Restore sdlc work-item list --json with the existing machine-readable report shape and zero exit code.
scope.reason: Automation needs the unscoped work-item inventory without a required work-item ID.

nonGoals.name: task-list-contract
nonGoals.description: Do not remove or weaken the explicit --work-item <work-item-id> requirement for sdlc task list.
nonGoals.reason: Task listing remains scoped to one selected work item.

nonGoals.name: discovery-semantics
nonGoals.description: Do not change work-item discovery ordering, report schemas, filesystem boundaries, malformed-record findings, or read-only behavior.
nonGoals.reason: This bugfix restores the intended argument boundary only.

nonGoals.name: provider-and-production-runtime
nonGoals.description: Do not add provider calls, HTTP services, persistence, deployment, or production release behavior.
nonGoals.reason: WI-0006 is limited to local CLI routing and regression coverage.

items.name: plain-work-item-list
items.description: sdlc work-item list must enumerate all valid work-item records without requiring --work-item <work-item-id>.
items.reason: The top-level work-item command is an inventory surface, not a selected-record query.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Running sdlc work-item list returns exit code zero and lists the repository work items in the existing deterministic order.
The command does not require, infer, or reject the absence of a work-item selector.

items.name: json-work-item-list
items.description: sdlc work-item list --json must return the existing machine-readable work-item report without requiring a selector.
items.reason: JSON consumers must be able to discover all work items from the top-level command.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Running sdlc work-item list --json returns exit code zero, valid JSON, schema sdlc-work-item-list/v1, and the complete discovered item set.

items.name: task-list-regression-boundary
items.description: The fix must preserve sdlc task list --work-item <work-item-id> selection and stable invalid-option behavior.
items.reason: WI-0003 established the explicit named option for selected task discovery and this bugfix must not regress it.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Focused tests continue to pass for task listing with --work-item WI-0001 and for missing or duplicate task-list selectors.

items.name: regression-coverage
items.description: Focused tests must cover both unscoped work-item-list forms and preserve read-only deterministic discovery behavior.
items.reason: The regression was introduced at the CLI routing boundary and needs executable coverage at that boundary.

acceptanceCriteria.description: yarn test passes with explicit plain and JSON unscoped work-item-list coverage and no mutation of discovered records.
